meta.title: Weights cannot be cleared back to an unweighted round
gaps: The happy-path weight save that should establish the qa_freight_adj weighted state cannot be expressed because no valid request body for that operation is provided.
The available read_round fields do not expose weight configuration, so the round's continued weighting and qa_freight_adj cannot be verified.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the trade edit weight parameters request, the request the case itself writes.
The buyer reads the pricing round.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Insufficient parameters”, and never with a server error.
